text:
tablet_felix: Erratic movement between bed_b1, kitchen_table_k1, and nightstand_b1. Day 7 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1 in the morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 first in the morning, then bed_b1 in the evening.

razor_felix: Consistently misidentified as sink_ba_ba1. Day 6 and day 7 feedback confirm it is at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Stop checking the sink; always check the shelf for grooming items.

mug_felix: Previously assumed to move to coffee_table_l1 in the evening based on Day 7 data. Day 9 22:32 feedback corrected this, showing it was at cupboard_k1. The "evening living room" pattern is unreliable. Check cupboard_k1 for stored drinkware, especially late at night.

charger_felix: Day 6 note suggested entry_hook_e1, but day 7 22:59 feedback shows it was at entry_floor_e1. The location is near the entry, but specifically on the floor, not the hook. Check entry_floor_e1 for charging accessories when residents are arriving or leaving.

glass_felix: Previously assumed to follow the mug to coffee_table_l1 in the evening. Day 9 22:59 feedback corrected this, showing it was at cupboard_k1. Like the mug, it does not consistently move to the living room. Check cupboard_k1 for stored drinkware, especially late at night.

water_bottle_felix: Day 6 feedback indicated kitchen_table_k1. No new evidence today, so keep this note. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.

book_felix: Day 6 feedback indicated bed_b1. No new evidence today, so keep this note. Check bed_b1 for reading materials.
